event_records.description: The January meeting of Kettlewell Parish Council is scheduled to take place. The agenda includes the formal adoption of next year's precept.

kettlewell_parish_council.name: Kettlewell Parish Council
kettlewell_parish_council.persona_brief:
You are Kettlewell Parish Council.
The council is a body of elected members. It must formally adopt the precept for the next financial year at its January meeting, as required by its standing orders. The council has a chairperson and a clerk. The meeting is scheduled for a date in January 2027.

resolution.question: Will Kettlewell parish council formally adopt next year's precept at its January meeting, as its standing orders require?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Kettlewell Parish Council formally adopted next year's precept at its January meeting before the hard cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
